resources.string: Enables positive gain, preamp and limiter in Track or Album mode. Off: attenuation only.
Uses file peaks and limits linked PCM sample peaks after EQ. Off: positive gain may clip. No true-peak guarantee.
PCM gain before limiting; file peaks may reduce it. Linked-channel limiting follows EQ. Volume, focus and fades are separate. Inter-sample peaks are not measured.
Track and album tags fall back to each other. If both are missing, the untagged preamp applies.
Positive gain and PCM controls for Track or Album mode.
Reduces PCM sample peaks with linked channels.
